notablePrerequisites: Empowered Autogenerator has at least four charge counters on it.
description:
Activate Empowered Autogenerator by tapping it, putting a charge counter on it and adding at least four mana of any color.
Cast Ancestral Statue by paying {4}.
Brimaz's first ability triggers, creating an Incubator artifact token.
When Ancestral Statue enters the battlefield, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Clock of Omens by tapping Ancestral Statue and the Incubator token, untapping Empowered Autogenerator.
Resolve the Ancestral Statue trigger, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
